svg.title: The data-generating process a GLM assumes
svg.desc: Left: a straight line theta transpose x, with a unit-variance Gaussian density drawn sideways at three values of x, and points scattered around the line as samples from those Gaussians. Right: an S-shaped curve giving the probability that y equals 1 at each x, with points at y equals 0 and y equals 1 that are mostly 0 on the left and mostly 1 on the right.
